# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

Almatica

# Proven Science. Empowered Solutions.

Company

### Who we are

Almatica, a subsidiary of Alvogen, is a specialty pharmaceuticals company that is focused on
developing innovative medicines.

Our portfolio is concentrated within the therapeutic areas of psychiatry and neurology. We are
dedicated to developing and improving medications in these therapeutic areas as well as in adjacent
diseases affecting the central nervous system.

[Our vision][19]
Vision

### Our guiding pillars

We are guided by pillars that shape who we are and what we stand for. Our focus on Integrity,
Science, Empathy and Evolution frames our approach as we work to provide better solutions to patient
needs.  

[Read more][20]
Products

### Our CNS portfolio

The Almatica CNS portfolio consists of products that address mental health and neurologic
conditions.

[CNS Portfolio][21]
Resources

### Patient support

To help a patient’s ability to afford and stay on their prescribed medications, Almatica provides
patient copay savings programs for several of its products.

[Read more][22]
Almatica

### Meet our management

The leadership team consists of leaders who are dedicated to fostering a dynamic change-driven
culture committed to meeting the needs of our customers. Our organizational structure is lean and
flexible, driving quick and effective decision making and the enabling the company to bring new
products quickly and safely to market.

[Read more][23]
Development

### Pipeline

Our pipeline is powered by end-to-end research and development capabilities, and our commitment to
operational excellence and patient safety ensures we consistently produce the highest-quality
medicines

# MOVING IN UNISON

We work as a flexible, attentive extension of your team; we offer the contract research organization
services you need to move your molecule from preclinical to Phase I, Phase II, and beyond.

Learn 5 practical strategies to reduce AI hallucination in clinical research to improve accuracy,
transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[Read now! ][17]

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]
  
  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody

debilitating diseases.

Founded in 2005, Anant Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. was built on a singular vision — to be a
specialized, collaborative partner to the pharmaceutical industry. Our name says it all. Anant is a
Sanskrit word meaning Infinite, and it captures exactly what we aspire to offer our clients:

solution is personalized to match your specific scientific, regulatory, and commercial requirements.

Leadership

## The people behind the science.

Every reference standard we release carries the expertise of a team that has spent decades at the
intersection of organic chemistry, analytical science, and pharmaceutical regulation.

[Dr Ajit Godbole]

Dr Ajit Godbole

### Director

Organic Chemistry

Dr. Ajit Godbole is a rare breed of leadership that seamlessly bridges the R&D lab and the
boardroom. Armed with a PhD in Chemistry and management credentials from SP Jain, Ajit combines deep
scientific expertise with sharp business acumen. He started his carrier in the pharma industry in
2001 as a Research associate and rose to heading a research lab in a large organization in 2010
before joining Anant as full time director. He doesn't just solve complex technical challenges—he
translates them into strategic, profitable growth. Above all, he is an exceptional mentor dedicated
to building and elevating high-performing teams.

[Dr Hormuzd Mulla]

Dr Hormuzd Mulla

### Chief Scientific Officer

Organic Synthesis

After completing his PhD from the University of Kentucky, Dr. Mulla held two post-doctoral research
positions; one in peptidomimetics at the University of Wisconsin, Madison and another postdoc in
glycolipids at Brown University in the US. With a strong background in organic chemistry, he has
worked in the early drug discovery domain since 2004 in different capacities from team leader to
senior lab management. With a passion for chemistry and a disciplined approach to problem-solving,
Dr. Mulla ensures that the science behind every project/product at Anant is uncompromising.

# Transit Time Finder

The Transit Time Finder provides you with the delivery date for a selected service.

You are required to select the Blue Dart service required by you, the Origin and Destination City
and the pick up date and time below.

To confirm if the service required by you is available, for the origin and destination selected,
please check with our [Location Finder][45]. For detailed information on our services, refer to our
[Service Guide][46].

**NOTE 1 :** The scheduled delivery date given is subject to the Terms And Conditions Of Carriage,
details of which are available in our [Service Guide][47].

**NOTE 2 :** Some locations in or around the city could be out of delivery area and may require
extra time for delivery - [Contact Customer Service][48].

**NOTE 3 :** Transit Time arrived at are on best estimate basis and it is advisable to [Contact
Customer Service][49] for your definite shipping needs.

**NOTE 4 :** Non documents shipments are subject to stricter customs, excise, and/or regulatory
checks which may cause delays - please refer further to disclaimer section.

# Price Finder

The Price Finder helps you to calculate your shipping charges for your service type needs.

Charges will be based on the weight of the shipment in kgs or fractions thereof and may be
assessible either on the gross weight of the shipment or the volume/dimensional weight of the
shipment - whichever is higher.

The chargeable weight may be expressed as fractions of a kg. such as 0.25 kgs or 0.5 kgs and may go
upto 9999 kgs.

If you wish to contact our centralized customer service [click here][50].

For information on Fuel Surcharge [click here][51].

  markets around the globe

specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical

facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing

## About Dr Sam Gartland

MB ChB BSc (Hons) MRCP (UK) FRACGP FASLM MSPMED

Hello, I am Sam Gartland. I am a doctor on the North Coast of NSW. In 2008 I was diagnosed with
Multiple Sclerosis. I was fortunate at this time to get lifesaving knowledge and guidance from
Professor George Jelinek and The Gawler Foundation.

The importance of Mental balance, Nutrition, Lifestyle and Connectedness became clear to me. These
insights informed my recovery then and my practice as a Doctor now. I have been relapse-free since
2009 and am in the best shape of my life. All diseases can be positively impacted by addressing
these issues and many reversed.

The purpose of this website is to empower others with the knowledge and resources to improve their
own health. The information presented here is the best available that I have found using my skills
and knowledge as a Doctor and as an informed patient.

## Lifestyle Medicine

Lifestyle Medicine is the foundation of good health.

Lifestyle Medicine is built on a foundation of evidence-based, peer-reviewed research that empowers
people to be active partners in their own healthcare. It is an approach to healthcare that goes
beyond the conventional status quo to deliver a truly holistic, 360-degree healthcare program.

We think of many chronic health conditions as ‘par for the course’ when it comes to modern life. But
it doesn’t have to be that way. Many of these can be prevented, stabilised and,  in some cases,
reversed by applying therapeutic lifestyle modifications. Conditions including Cardiovascular
Disease, Type 2 Diabetes,  Neurological Conditions and mental health conditions all share common
risk factors that can be positively addressed with Lifestyle Medicine.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

[See the raw data →][7]

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## Pharma-Logistik Know-How par Excellence


**Wir setzen Maßstäbe bei der Pharma-Logistik**

kleinen Schritt voraus und setzen mit innovativen Konzepten Maßstäbe in unserer Branche. Bei aller
High-End-Technologie steht für uns aber stets ein Grundsatz im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns: die
Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

Wir richten unsere Logistikkonzepte individuell für Sie an ihren Anforderungen und an Ihren Märkten
aus, immer gemäß den höchsten Ansprüchen an Qualität und Flexibilität in der Pharma-Industrie.
Unsere ganzheitlichen Pharma Supply Chain Lösungen gewährleisten die strenge Einhaltung der
gesetzlichen Vorschriften sowie der GMP- und GDP-Richtlinien.

und Teil unseres hohen Qualitätsanspruchs. Alle Mitarbeiter werden in speziellen Programmen
geschult. Durch interne Audits wird das Wissen und Handeln regelmäßig überprüft, um eine optimale

Die redundant angelegten Temperaturerfassungssysteme für Transport und Lagerung werden jährlich
durch kalibrierte Messgeräte überprüft. Wir modifizieren unsere Prozesse, wenn erforderlich. Diese
Change Control wird selbstverständlich dokumentiert. Regelmäßige Kundenaudits und auch interne
Audits sind für uns ein umfangreiches Überprüfungssystem, dem wir uns jederzeit gerne stellen.

DIN EN ISO 9001:2015 zertifiziert

Seit vielen Jahren sind unsere Unternehmensbereiche nach DIN EN ISO 9001 zertifiziert.

GDP zertifiziert

Ein gültiges GDP-Zertifikat zeigt, dass Frigo-Trans bei sämtlichen Serviceleistungen auf Qualität
achtet und ein zuverlässiger Partner in der Lieferkette der Pharma-Industrie ist. Um dies sicher zu
stellen sind alle unsere Gebäude / Lager wie auch Fahrzeuge für ihren Einsatzzweck qualifiziert und
alle Mitarbeiter entsprechend geschult.

TAPA TSR 1 und TAPA FSR A zertifiziert

Als Mitglied der Transport Asset Protection Association (TAPA) bieten wir den höchsten
Sicherheitsstandard sowohl in Distribution als auch in der Lagerhaltung. Besonders gesicherte
Transporteinheiten (Pharma-Liner®), geschultes Fahrerpersonal in Verbindung mit einer sicheren
Routenplanung und GEO-Fencing garantieren 365 Tage im Jahr einen umfassenden Schutz auf dem gesamten
europäischen Streckennetz.

Unsere Pharma-Hubs werden vom Werkschutz 24/7 kontrolliert und gesichert. Die Gelände sind mit
TAPA-konformen Zaunanlagen umgeben und zudem Tag und Nacht Video überwacht. Schrankenanlagen
verhindern das unerlaubte Einfahren von Fremdfahrzeugen.

Reglementierter Beauftragter

Mit dem Status als reglementierter Beauftragter sind wir in der Lage, sichere Luftfracht von einem
bekannten Versender zum Flughafen zu transportieren, aber auch unsichere Fracht sicher zu machen.

Großhandelserlaubnis nach § 52a AMG

Seit November 2012 ist Frigo-Trans im Besitz der Großhandelserlaubnis nach § 52a AMG, ein weiterer
Beleg für unser pharmagerechtes Handeln und Denken.

GxP konformes Handeln und transparente Prozessabläufe, die überprüf- und nachvollziehbar sind,
gepaart mit Redundanz in allen sicherheits- und qualitätsrelevanten Bereichen. Davon sind wir
überzeugt.

## Pharma-Logistik Know-How par Excellence


**Wir setzen Maßstäbe bei der Pharma-Logistik**

Seit mehr als drei Jahrzehnten bieten wir unseren Kunden modernste Pharma-Logistik und
zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für den Transport und die Lagerung von hochsensiblen Gütern. Ob
Echtzeitdaten, komplettes Monitoring, umfangreiche Zertifizierungen, höchste Sicherheitsstandards
oder bestens ausgebildete und motivierte Mitarbeiter*innen – wir sind unserer Zeit immer einen
kleinen Schritt voraus und setzen mit innovativen Konzepten Maßstäbe in unserer Branche. Bei aller
High-End-Technologie steht für uns aber stets ein Grundsatz im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns: die
Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

Wir richten unsere Logistikkonzepte individuell für Sie an ihren Anforderungen und an Ihren Märkten
aus, immer gemäß den höchsten Ansprüchen an Qualität und Flexibilität in der Pharma-Industrie.
Unsere ganzheitlichen Pharma Supply Chain Lösungen gewährleisten die strenge Einhaltung der
gesetzlichen Vorschriften sowie der GMP- und GDP-Richtlinien.

Mit unserem Know-how und unserer Erfahrung helfen wir Ihnen bei der Erarbeitung und dem Ausbau Ihrer

## Quality Management System / Security

**Als einziges Logistikunternehmen in Europa vereinen wir an unserem Standort in Fußgönheim
Zertifizierungen gemäß GDP, TAPA TSR 1 und TAPA FSR A unter einem Dach und halten neben dem Status
des reglementierten Beauftragten auch eine Großhandelserlaubnis nach §52a AMG. Daher stehen wir
nicht nur für ein hohes Maß an Produktintegrität, sondern auch für die Sicherheit Ihrer Produkte.**

Die Einhaltung der aktuellen GMP- und GDP-Richtlinien sowie des AMG ist für uns selbstverständlich
und Teil unseres hohen Qualitätsanspruchs. Alle Mitarbeiter werden in speziellen Programmen
geschult. Durch interne Audits wird das Wissen und Handeln regelmäßig überprüft, um eine optimale
Performance zu erreichen.
Die redundant angelegten Temperaturerfassungssysteme für Transport und Lagerung werden jährlich
durch kalibrierte Messgeräte überprüft. Wir modifizieren unsere Prozesse, wenn erforderlich. Diese
Change Control wird selbstverständlich dokumentiert. Regelmäßige Kundenaudits und auch interne
Audits sind für uns ein umfangreiches Überprüfungssystem, dem wir uns jederzeit gerne stellen.

DIN EN ISO 9001:2015 zertifiziert

Seit vielen Jahren sind unsere Unternehmensbereiche nach DIN EN ISO 9001 zertifiziert.

GDP zertifiziert

Ein gültiges GDP-Zertifikat zeigt, dass Frigo-Trans bei sämtlichen Serviceleistungen auf Qualität
achtet und ein zuverlässiger Partner in der Lieferkette der Pharma-Industrie ist. Um dies sicher zu
stellen sind alle unsere Gebäude / Lager wie auch Fahrzeuge für ihren Einsatzzweck qualifiziert und
alle Mitarbeiter entsprechend geschult.

TAPA TSR 1 und TAPA FSR A zertifiziert

Als Mitglied der Transport Asset Protection Association (TAPA) bieten wir den höchsten
Sicherheitsstandard sowohl in Distribution als auch in der Lagerhaltung. Besonders gesicherte
Transporteinheiten (Pharma-Liner®), geschultes Fahrerpersonal in Verbindung mit einer sicheren
Routenplanung und GEO-Fencing garantieren 365 Tage im Jahr einen umfassenden Schutz auf dem gesamten
europäischen Streckennetz.

Unsere Pharma-Hubs werden vom Werkschutz 24/7 kontrolliert und gesichert. Die Gelände sind mit
TAPA-konformen Zaunanlagen umgeben und zudem Tag und Nacht Video überwacht. Schrankenanlagen
verhindern das unerlaubte Einfahren von Fremdfahrzeugen.

Reglementierter Beauftragter

Mit dem Status als reglementierter Beauftragter sind wir in der Lage, sichere Luftfracht von einem
bekannten Versender zum Flughafen zu transportieren, aber auch unsichere Fracht sicher zu machen.

Großhandelserlaubnis nach § 52a AMG

Seit November 2012 ist Frigo-Trans im Besitz der Großhandelserlaubnis nach § 52a AMG, ein weiterer
Beleg für unser pharmagerechtes Handeln und Denken.

überzeugt.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

### Optimise your health, reverse disease and feel well with high-level expert health care at Life
### Medical Mullumbimby.

Life Medical Mullumbimby offers high-level primary care provided by Doctors with expert knowledge of
Lifestyle Medicine. Our team are committed to empowering you with the skills and knowledge to
optimise your health.

Life Medical Mullumbimby is proud to be an independent GP-owned and led practice.

How we can support you
* ## General Practice
  
  Life Medical Mullumbimby is an integrated practice providing exceptional primary healthcare to the
  community. Our GPs are caring, compassionate and experienced in the care of both adults and
  children. Our approach is grounded in the best of conventional medicine and informed by Lifestyle
  Medicine to manage acute, chronic and complex conditions.
* ## Lifestyle Medicine
  
  We recognise that the cause of many chronic health conditions can be found in modern life.
  Lifestyle Medicine is an effective approach to managing these conditions because it incorporates a
  “common sense” approach as the foundation of good health; this ethos is at the heart of everything
  we do. At Life Medicine Mullumbimby, we empower patients to make lifestyle modifications that
  treat the underlying causes as part of an effective, sustainable care plan.
* ## Allied Health
  
  Sometimes the best health outcomes are achieved by accessing a multi-disciplinary team of allied
  health professionals to create a personalised treatment plan. University-qualified practitioners
  deliver health services to prevent, diagnose, manage and treat conditions or illnesses, making
  them a natural fit for our “whole person” ethos at Life Medical Mullumbimby.

## FAQ’S about Lifestyle Medicine
* What is Lifestyle Medicine?
  
  Lifestyle Medicine is an approach that empowers people to make changes to their lifestyle to
  stabilise and, in some cases, reverse disease and improve their quality of life. Lifestyle
  Medicine uses evidence-based principles to address the underlying causes of disease. It typically
  includes modifying areas such as nutrition, movement, exercise, stress management, and community,
  along with equipping patients with the tools to avoid risky substances. The ultimate goal is to
  empower people with the skills and knowledge to optimise their health and improve their quality of
  life.
* How does Lifestyle Medicine differ from conventional medicine?
  
  Lifestyle Medicine treats the underlying causes of illness rather than the symptoms. It has a
  strong emphasis on prevention, improving quality of life and optimising physical and mental
  health. It is a patient-centred approach to health that empowers people to take an active role in
  their health.
  
  Lifestyle Medicine is a comprehensive and evidence-based approach to health that empowers people
  to address the underlying causes of health issues. Whereas conventional medicine relies on
  medicine and surgery to manage disease, a Lifestyle Medicine approach utilises the power of
  healthy lifestyle choices, nutrition, exercise, stress management and social support, alongside
  conventional treatments to ensure the best possible outcomes, reduce the need for medications and
  improve overall well-being.
* What types of therapies are included in Lifestyle Medicine?
  
  Lifestyle Medicine is built on six key pillars that form the foundation of its approach to health
  and wellness:
  
  1. Nutrition: Emphasising whole, plant-based foods and minimising processed foods, sugar, and
  unhealthy fats to nourish the body and prevent chronic diseases.
  
  2. Physical Activity: Encouraging regular exercise and movement to improve cardiovascular health,
  strength, flexibility, and mental well-being.
  
  3. Stress Management: Teaching techniques such as mindfulness, meditation, deep breathing, and
  relaxation exercises to reduce stress levels and promote emotional resilience.
  
  4. Sleep Optimisation: Highlighting the importance of sufficient, restorative sleep for overall
  health, cognitive function, mood regulation, and immune function.

## FAQ’S about Lifestyle Medicine
* What is Lifestyle Medicine?
  
  Lifestyle Medicine is an approach that empowers people to make changes to their lifestyle to
  stabilise and, in some cases, reverse disease and improve their quality of life. Lifestyle
  Medicine uses evidence-based principles to address the underlying causes of disease. It typically
  includes modifying areas such as nutrition, movement, exercise, stress management, and community,
  along with equipping patients with the tools to avoid risky substances. The ultimate goal is to
  empower people with the skills and knowledge to optimise their health and improve their quality of
  life.
* How does Lifestyle Medicine differ from conventional medicine?
  
  Lifestyle Medicine treats the underlying causes of illness rather than the symptoms. It has a
  strong emphasis on prevention, improving quality of life and optimising physical and mental
  health. It is a patient-centred approach to health that empowers people to take an active role in
  their health.
  
  Lifestyle Medicine is a comprehensive and evidence-based approach to health that empowers people
  to address the underlying causes of health issues. Whereas conventional medicine relies on
  medicine and surgery to manage disease, a Lifestyle Medicine approach utilises the power of
  healthy lifestyle choices, nutrition, exercise, stress management and social support, alongside
  conventional treatments to ensure the best possible outcomes, reduce the need for medications and
  improve overall well-being.
* What types of therapies are included in Lifestyle Medicine?
  
  Lifestyle Medicine is built on six key pillars that form the foundation of its approach to health
  and wellness:
  
  1. Nutrition: Emphasising whole, plant-based foods and minimising processed foods, sugar, and
  unhealthy fats to nourish the body and prevent chronic diseases.
  
  2. Physical Activity: Encouraging regular exercise and movement to improve cardiovascular health,
  strength, flexibility, and mental well-being.
  
  3. Stress Management: Teaching techniques such as mindfulness, meditation, deep breathing, and
  relaxation exercises to reduce stress levels and promote emotional resilience.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## One capsule, two important benefits

[150 mg and 200 mg capsules (not actual size)]

### Reduce pill burden

Achieve 150 mg or 200 mg dosage with ONE capsule[1][10]

### Support adherence

A single capsule vs multiple pills has the potential to increase patient adherence to
treatment[2][11]

### A real-world retrospective analysis showed that patients taking one pill a day (vs multiple
### pills) improved adherence.[2][12]

Stabilized patients on a lower pill burden had statistically higher adherence and were more likely
to remain persistent throughout the 1-year post-index period vs patients on a higher pill burden but
the same overall dose.[2][13]

#### Probability of remaining persistent on sertraline[†][14]

[Chart]

Kaplan-Meier survival curves for probability of remaining persistent with sertraline during the
1-year post-index period for patients who achieved stable dose on different pill regimens. This
chart shows Cohort 2 (1 x 100 mg) vs Cohort 3 (2 x 50 mg).[2][15]

To view the complete retrospective study, including this graph and a table of the number of people
in each cohort, see Wang G, et al. Int J Clin Pract. 2021.

NOTE: The sertraline tablets referred to in this study were not Almatica products.

## Important Safety Information 

**WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS**

**Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult
patients. Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening and for
emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors.**

### INDICATION FOR USE

Sertraline HCl Capsules is indicated for the treatment of major depressive disorder in adults and
obsessive-compulsive disorder in adults and pediatric patients 6 years and older.

### CONTRAINDICATIONS

Sertraline HCl Capsules is contraindicated in patients:
* Taking, or within 14 days of stopping, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) because of an
  increased risk of serotonin syndrome
* Taking pimozide
* With known hypersensitivity to sertraline or the excipients in Sertraline HCl Capsules (eg,
  anaphylaxis, angioedema)

### WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS

#### Serotonin Syndrome
* Sertraline HCl Capsules can precipitate serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening
  condition. The risk is increased with concomitant use of other serotonergic drugs and with drugs
  that impair metabolism of serotonin.

#### Increased Risk of Bleeding
* Sertraline HCl Capsules increases the risk of bleeding events. Concomitant use of aspirin,
  nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), other antiplatelet drugs, warfarin, and other
  anticoagulants may add to this risk. There is an association between drugs that interfere with
  serotonin reuptake and the occurrence of gastrointestinal bleeding. Exposure to SSRIs,
  particularly in the month before delivery, has been associated with a less than 2-fold increase in
  the risk of postpartum hemorrhage.

#### Activation of Mania or Hypomania
* In patients with bipolar disorder, treating a depressive episode with Sertraline HCl Capsules may
  precipitate a mixed/manic episode. Prior to treatment, screen patients for any personal or family
  history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania.

#### Discontinuation Syndrome
* Adverse reactions after discontinuation of serotonergic antidepressants, particularly after abrupt
  discontinuation, include: nausea, sweating, dysphoric mood, irritability, agitation, dizziness,
  sensory disturbances, tremor, anxiety, confusion, headache, lethargy, emotional lability,
  insomnia, hypomania, tinnitus, and seizures. A gradual reduction in dosage rather than abrupt
  cessation is recommended.

#### Seizures
* Sertraline HCl Capsules has not been systematically evaluated in patients with seizure disorder
  and should be prescribed with caution in these patients.

* Sertraline HCl Capsules can precipitate serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening

  that impair metabolism of serotonin.

* Sertraline HCl Capsules increases the risk of bleeding events. Concomitant use of aspirin,
  nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), other antiplatelet drugs, warfarin, and other
  anticoagulants may add to this risk. There is an association between drugs that interfere with
  serotonin reuptake and the occurrence of gastrointestinal bleeding. Exposure to SSRIs,
  particularly in the month before delivery, has been associated with a less than 2-fold increase in
  the risk of postpartum hemorrhage.

#### Activation of Mania or Hypomania
* In patients with bipolar disorder, treating a depressive episode with Sertraline HCl Capsules may
  precipitate a mixed/manic episode. Prior to treatment, screen patients for any personal or family
  history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania.

#### Discontinuation Syndrome
* Adverse reactions after discontinuation of serotonergic antidepressants, particularly after abrupt
  discontinuation, include: nausea, sweating, dysphoric mood, irritability, agitation, dizziness,
  sensory disturbances, tremor, anxiety, confusion, headache, lethargy, emotional lability,
  insomnia, hypomania, tinnitus, and seizures. A gradual reduction in dosage rather than abrupt
  cessation is recommended.

#### Seizures
* Sertraline HCl Capsules has not been systematically evaluated in patients with seizure disorder
  and should be prescribed with caution in these patients.

#### Angle-Closure Glaucoma
* Sertraline HCl Capsules may trigger an angle closure attack in a patient with anatomically narrow
  angles who does not have a patent iridectomy. Avoid use in patients with untreated anatomically
  narrow angles.

#### Hyponatremia
* Hyponatremia may occur with Sertraline HCl Capsules. In patients with symptomatic hyponatremia,
  discontinue Sertraline HCl Capsules and institute appropriate medical intervention. Elderly
  patients, patients taking diuretics, and those who are volume-depleted may be at greater risk of
  developing hyponatremia.

#### False-Positive Effects on Screening Tests for Benzodiazepines
* False-positive urine immunoassay screening tests for benzodiazepines have been reported in
  patients taking another Sertraline HCl product and may be expected for several days following
  discontinuation of sertraline.

#### QTc Prolongation
* During post-marketing use of sertraline, cases of QTc prolongation and Torsade de Pointes (TdP)
  have been reported. Sertraline should be used with caution in patients with risk factors for QTc
  prolongation.

#### Reactions to FD&C Yellow No. 5 (Tartrazine)
* Sertraline HCl Capsules contain FD&C Yellow No. 5 (tartrazine), which may cause allergic-type
  reactions in certain individuals, seen frequently in patients who also have aspirin
  hypersensitivity.

#### Sexual Dysfunction
* Sertraline HCl Capsules may cause symptoms of sexual dysfunction. In male patients, use may result
  in ejaculatory delay or failure, decreased libido, and erectile dysfunction. In female patients,
  use may result in decreased libido and delayed or absent orgasm.

### ADVERSE REACTIONS
* Most frequent adverse reactions in pooled placebo-controlled clinical trials were nausea, diarrhea
  / loose stool, tremor, dyspepsia, decreased appetite, hyperhidrosis, ejaculation failure, and
  decreased libido. In trials for major depressive disorder, somnolence was also seen. In trials for
  obsessive-compulsive disorder, insomnia and agitation were also seen.

* Hyponatremia may occur with Sertraline HCl Capsules. In patients with symptomatic hyponatremia,
  discontinue Sertraline HCl Capsules and institute appropriate medical intervention. Elderly
  patients, patients taking diuretics, and those who are volume-depleted may be at greater risk of
  developing hyponatremia.

#### False-Positive Effects on Screening Tests for Benzodiazepines
* False-positive urine immunoassay screening tests for benzodiazepines have been reported in
  patients taking another Sertraline HCl product and may be expected for several days following
  discontinuation of sertraline.

#### QTc Prolongation
* During post-marketing use of sertraline, cases of QTc prolongation and Torsade de Pointes (TdP)
  have been reported. Sertraline should be used with caution in patients with risk factors for QTc
  prolongation.

#### Reactions to FD&C Yellow No. 5 (Tartrazine)
* Sertraline HCl Capsules contain FD&C Yellow No. 5 (tartrazine), which may cause allergic-type
  reactions in certain individuals, seen frequently in patients who also have aspirin
  hypersensitivity.

#### Sexual Dysfunction
* Sertraline HCl Capsules may cause symptoms of sexual dysfunction. In male patients, use may result
  in ejaculatory delay or failure, decreased libido, and erectile dysfunction. In female patients,
  use may result in decreased libido and delayed or absent orgasm.

### ADVERSE REACTIONS
* Most frequent adverse reactions in pooled placebo-controlled clinical trials were nausea, diarrhea
  / loose stool, tremor, dyspepsia, decreased appetite, hyperhidrosis, ejaculation failure, and
  decreased libido. In trials for major depressive disorder, somnolence was also seen. In trials for
  obsessive-compulsive disorder, insomnia and agitation were also seen.

uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

COMPANY PROFILE

At TLC we specialize in the custom synthesis of complex organic compounds for use as reference
standards by the bio-medical and pharmaceutical industries around the world.
Download TLC Brochure
UNCOMPROMISED QUALITY
At TLC, quality is not just a commitment, it is ingrained in our culture. Our extensive COA, which
includes HPLC, NMR, MS, IR, EA, GC, Water Content, residual solvents and Assay, coupled with **ISO
17034** and **ISO 17025** accreditations, serves as a testament to our unwavering dedication to
delivering products that meet the highest standards of excellence in the industry.
EXTENSIVE INVENTORY
TLC currently offers over 24,000 certified reference standards from stock and we add approximately
2,000 new standards yearly. Our product line includes Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), drug
impurities and metabolite standards, as well as their stable isotope labelled analogues and amino
acid/peptide drug standards.

Download TLC Brochure
UNCOMPROMISED QUALITY
At TLC, quality is not just a commitment, it is ingrained in our culture. Our extensive COA, which
includes HPLC, NMR, MS, IR, EA, GC, Water Content, residual solvents and Assay, coupled with **ISO
17034** and **ISO 17025** accreditations, serves as a testament to our unwavering dedication to
delivering products that meet the highest standards of excellence in the industry.
EXTENSIVE INVENTORY
TLC currently offers over 24,000 certified reference standards from stock and we add approximately
2,000 new standards yearly. Our product line includes Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), drug
impurities and metabolite standards, as well as their stable isotope labelled analogues and amino
acid/peptide drug standards.

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

overall understanding of the current market scenario.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[[Tablets]][21]

Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
